heroSubtitle: Celebrating the voices that shaped our inaugural festival and looking forward to future competitions.

openMicNight.introBody:
After Hurricane Melissa, we know you have stories — old and new — to share!

**VPF is calling all poets, wordsmiths, and lovers of spoken word!**

We're bringing the stage to your screen with our first-ever Virtual Open Mic Night!
openMicNight.performInfoBody:
Registration is temporarily closed while we finalize the new date. Check back soon for updates!

In the meantime, feel free to reach out at vibrationspoetryfestival@gmail.com with any questions.
opportunities: Share your poem inspired by Nature's Fury
Connect with a vibrant creative community
openMicNight.statusBody:
We know many of you were excited to share your voices, your stories, and your creativity—and we truly appreciate your passion and support.

But don't worry! This is not a cancellation—just a brief pause. A new date will be announced soon, and when we return, it's going to be even more powerful, more inspiring, and full of the vibrant energy that defines our community.

**Thank you for your understanding. Thank you for your patience. And above all—thank you for keeping the VIBRATIONS alive. Stay tuned, stay safe, and stay inspired.**
openMicNight.title: VIBRATIONS OPEN MIC NIGHT – VIRTUAL EDITION!

heritageChallenge.poemCardText: Bent's poem is a fearless confrontation of the everyday injustices women face and a passionate call for respect, dignity, and autonomy. Her work perfectly captures the spirit of October's theme and embodies exactly what this challenge was about.
heritageChallenge.collaboration: Vibrations Poetry Festival & Brain Edibles Collection
heritageChallenge.theme: Poetry on Justice, Injustice, and the Pursuit of Peace
heritageChallenge.introBody: Congratulations to **Tanisha Bent** on winning Vibrations Poetry Festival's Heritage Month Poetry & Human Rights Challenge with her powerful piece, **"In Her Skin."**
heritageChallenge.collaborationText: Vibrations Poetry Festival in collaboration with Brain Edibles Collection
nextSteps: Feature in Vibrations Poetry Festival Showcase 2025 — A dedicated profile celebrating her work and artistry
Interview Spotlight — An in-depth conversation about her poetry, inspirations, and creative journey
Publication Across Digital Channels — Her winning poem will be shared on our website, social media, and promotional materials
heritageChallenge.quote: Injustice anywhere is a threat to justice everywhere.

competitionRecap.dates: August 9, 2025 • Edna Manley College • Kingston, Jamaica
competitionRecap.overviewText: The inaugural Vibrations Poetry Festival Competition brought together Jamaica's most talented emerging and established poets for an unforgettable evening of spoken word artistry. Open to all Jamaican poets and poetry enthusiasts, this competition celebrated the power of the written and performed word.

futureSection.heading: Future Poetry Competitions
futureSection.body:
The success of our inaugural competition and the Heritage Month Poetry & Human Rights Challenge has inspired us to make this an annual tradition. Stay tuned for announcements about the 2026 Vibrations Poetry Festival Competition!

Want to be the first to know about upcoming competitions and festival news? [Subscribe to our newsletter](/contact) and follow us on social media.
